<!-- pr-reviewer: d9c799c13a1fc40396c49e961b494eeeb657e64b -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. This is the independent safety-floor review of the head.

What looks good:
- crates/motion/src/finishing3d/raster_bridge.rs: a same-line gap becomes one straight feed only under three gates, all refusable: the span is at most the tool diameter, the climb is no steeper than the march's own slope law plus tol, and the exact swept-sphere test (dist_seg_tri against the support facets) certifies r - chord clearance. NaN or non-finite inputs fail the compares and keep the break. The direction is fail-safe: no certification, no bridge.
- A hole the ball fits into keeps the clean hop, so the land model stays the user's switch (pin: a_hole_the_ball_fits_into_keeps_a_clean_hop).
- The swarf family moved out of raster.rs to keep files near 400 lines, with a stated cost-to-change note.

Results, built locally on the trial merge with main 7bcc13a4b (clean):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test finish3d_holes | 5 passed |
| cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test finish3d | 55 passed, 33 ignored |
| cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib | 427 passed, 10 ignored |
| flow / scallop_ceiling / center_cut_posed / swarf_pose_continuity / refusal_ghost_frames | 13 / 4 / 9 / 6 / 3 passed, 0 failed |
| cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -D warnings | pass |

Not run here: the camcraft-app suites. The diff changes no app file; the app CL-golden path was green in the author's quick gate named in the PR body.

Requested before merge: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
